svg.title: One empty result, three different worlds
svg.desc: An empty result can come from pages that were never read, from phrasings the lexical channel never covered, or from every N×M comparison scoring below the threshold. Only the third case is a bounded absence. In the recorded run the claim Flock 摄像头采购 scored 0.25 against tau 0.62 with 84 comparisons, the lexical channel only, so the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE and the attestation records lexical_only.
